bigworld.config.bwLspPath.description: Absolute path of the bw-lsp binary. Leave empty to use the one built next to this extension (build it with the cmake entitydef sample).
bigworld.config.resRoot.description: Resource root of the BigWorld project to inspect (the directory that contains scripts/entities.xml). Leave empty to find it from the opened def file.
